The Ensuring Lasting Smiles Act sounds compassionate—until you check the receipts. HHS spending ballooned 41.7% from $1.2T to $1.7T between 2019-2024. Now they want to mandate coverage without addressing why existing Medicaid funds aren’t prioritized for these critical needs.

The bill’s dental/orthodontic provisions (Section 2(a)(3)(A)(ii)) could add layers of bureaucracy rather than streamline care. Why create new programs when current budgets already hemorrhage cash?

Redirect existing waste instead of expanding the fiscal black hole.
